subject: Elara Health: request for uptime concession + commercial discount
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: 
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Elara ask: uptime tolerance + 25% pilot discount (details + attachments)

Hi Soojin / Marissa,

Quick summary from this morning's sync with Elara Health (Ali + Priya): they're ready to commit to a 12-month Dedicated plan if we can:
- relax the uptime SLO from 99.9% to 99.5% for the initial 6-month pilot, and
- cap service credits during pilot to 5% MRC (they asked to remove our default 10% cap), and
- get a 25% volume discount for months 1-6 staged as a pilot incentive.

They cited tight procurement cycles and an upcoming customer launch on July 1; their infra cost model won't tolerate more than 2 hours/month of scheduled/unplanned downtime for the pilot. They asked us to put the concession into the MSA exhibit so Legal can move quickly.

I've attached the SOW v3 and a brief spreadsheet showing their expected token volumes and expected spend. Key risk items below:
- Reduced SLO increases our operational exposure (we'll need clear runbook + auto-fallback to smaller model if latency spikes).
- Capped credits at 5% reduces financial protection for them; Legal may want a precise remedy formula.

Can you advise if Deal Desk + Exec signoff is required here (discount + nonstandard SLO)? If so, can we get a path to a yes by next Wednesday? Elara will go to competitive bid if we delay.

Thanks,
Ben

Attachments:
- Elara_SOW_v3.pdf (PDF, 1.2MB)
- DowntimeMetricProposal.xlsx (Excel, 28KB)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Elara ask: uptime tolerance + 25% pilot discount (details + attachments)

Thanks Ben — looping in Lauren for exec view and Marissa for Deal Desk pricing/legal coordination.

Marissa, proposed operational mitigations I'd like validated before any concession is accepted:
- Pilot SLO: 99.5% uptime for months 1–6 only, auto-revert to standard 99.9% at month 7 unless both parties agree to extend.
- Credits: cap at 5% monthly credit during pilot; for any single outage > 60m we apply a defined per-incident credit schedule (see attached Excel).
- Monitoring & runbook: Elara must enable token-level tracing and offload heavy batch jobs to scheduled maintenance windows; we'll require a 7-day rollback notice for major model/infra flips.
- Pricing: 25% discount months 1–6 on committed usage (commit threshold detailed in SOW); 0% discount thereafter unless usage meets commit.

This is a bundle of a commercial concession + a nonstandard SLO. My ask to Lauren: do we accept this as a Deal Desk + Exec-approved concession if Legal and Finance sign the redlines that include the auto-revert and the incident credit schedule? Alternative is to offer a smaller pilot discount (15%) and require a shorter SLO deviation (3 months).

Quote from Ben's notes included below. I attached proposed_contract_redlines.docx with inline changes.

Soojin

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 08:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Elara ask: uptime tolerance + 25% pilot discount (details + attachments)

Thanks for the clear ask and options. I support a controlled concession with these guardrails:
- Approve 99.5% uptime for a 6-month pilot, conditional on an auto-revert to 99.9% at month 7 unless both parties sign an amendment.
- Approve capped service credits at 5% for the pilot, but Legal must ensure the incident credit schedule has a per-incident cap and clear definitions for "downtime", "maintenance", and "scheduled maintenance".
- Approve a reduced pilot discount of 20% (instead of 25%) for months 1–6; authorise Deal Desk to offer 20% if Elara signs the revised SOW by COB Friday, May 28.
- Require a 30-day performance review clause at month 3 of the pilot — if error rates/latency exceed thresholds we can pause the pilot pricing and revert to standard rates with 45 days notice.

Finance and Legal — please review attached redlines. This approval is conditioned on Finance confirming the margin impact is acceptable and Legal confirming the risk language on remedies. If Finance objects, reduce the pilot discount to 10% and proceed only with Legal signoff.

Please confirm by EOD tomorrow and Ben, prepare DocuSign with the updated Exhibit so we can close this by Friday.

- Lauren

Hi Ali / Priya — good news: Redwood can proceed with a constrained pilot concession. Summary of final commercial path and next steps: 

1) Pilot terms (months 1–6): 99.5% uptime, capped service credits at 5% MRC, pilot discount 20% on committed usage.
2) Auto-revert to standard 99.9% uptime at month 7 unless both parties amend.
3) 30-day performance review at month 3; see Exhibit B for metric thresholds and pause provisions.
4) Legal has redlined the MSA and attached; please review and return by COB May 28.
5) DocuSign envelope has been created for the revised SOW and amendment: https://www.docusign.net/Elara-RDW-8421?envelopeId=0a1b2c3d

If you sign by Friday we will lock in the pilot pricing and schedule a kickoff for June 7. If we do not receive an exec-signed SOW by the deadline, the concession offer will expire and we'll revert to standard commercial terms.

Thanks everyone — Ben
